description: This file defines the ResourceIdentifier class, which manages and parses resource path identifiers used within the Hono framework. It includes methods for constructing, manipulating, and inspecting resource identifiers represented as path segments, often for identifying resources within the telemetry and registration endpoints.

classes.name: ResourceIdentifier
classes.description: A class to handle and parse resource path identifiers, allowing creation from strings or path segments, and providing accessors to components such as endpoint, tenant ID, resource ID, and full path.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates a resource identifier from its string representation without assuming a default tenant.

methods.name: fromStringAssumingDefaultTenant
methods.description: Creates a resource identifier from its string representation assuming the default tenant.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Constructs a resource identifier given an endpoint, optional tenantId, and optional resourceId.

methods.name: from(ResourceIdentifier, String, String)
methods.description: Creates a new ResourceIdentifier based on an existing one, overriding tenantId and resourceId.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the endpoint segment of the resource identifier.

methods.name: getTenantId
methods.description: Returns the tenant ID component, if set.

methods.name: getResourceId
methods.description: Returns the resource ID component, if set.

methods.name: toPath
methods.description: Returns a copy of the resource path segments.

methods.name: elementAt
methods.description: Returns the resource path element at the specified index.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the number of segments in the resource path.

methods.name: getBasePath
methods.description: Returns the string representing the endpoint and tenant ID, i.e., base path.

methods.name: getPathWithoutBase
methods.description: Returns the part of the path excluding the base path.

methods.name: hasEventEndpoint
methods.description: Checks if the endpoint corresponds to an event endpoint type.
